title: Best Sweet Potato Slices
summary: Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, these Baked Sweet Potato Slices are made with just 2 ingredients and make for a delicious base for both sweet and savory toppings.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil of choice (avocado, olive, or coconut oil)
Optional Seasonings: cinnamon, cumin, Smoked paprika, chili powder, curry powder, oregano, etc.
steps: Prep the sweet potatoes - scrub really well to remove any dirt and bacteria. Dry throughly with a kitchen towel. Using a sharp knife, slice into 1/2 inch rounds. Drizzle oil and make sure all the round slices are coated well to ensure a crispy exterior and a soft interior.
Arrange the rounds in single layer on the prepared baking pan. Bake for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden brown.
Enjoy as is or add whatever toppings you wish.
